rules: Validate all file paths before fs operations to prevent directory traversal
Enforce authentication middleware on all public endpoints
Use path.resolve() and normalize paths to safe directories
Avoid eval() and dynamic code execution with unsanitized input
For lowdb file paths: resolve input against a base directory, normalize, and verify it remains within the base (no ../ escapes)
For fs operations: use path.join(baseDir, userInput) and path.resolve() then verify startsWith(baseDir) before access
Do not accept absolute paths or paths containing ../ from user input
MANDATORY: Validate all JSON payloads in POST/PUT operations against schema.json before persisting to lowdb
Use JSON Schema validator (ajv or equivalent) to enforce type constraints and reject malformed structures
Return 400 Bad Request with validation errors when payload does not conform to schema
CRITICAL: Never commit credentials, API keys, passwords, or PII to test fixtures (fixtures/db.json, fixtures/db.json5)
Use environment variables or placeholder values for sensitive data in fixtures
